title: Nehemiah Rebuilds the Wall
lines: This is Nehemiah, who was a Jewish man who worked for a Persian king, Artaxerxes, the king of Babylon.
這是尼希米，他是猶太人，在波斯王亞達薛西手下做事，那王也統治巴比倫。
Many of the Jews had been sent to Babylon years before because they had disobeyed God.
多年前，許多猶太人因為違背神，被擄到巴比倫。
One day Nehemiah heard a report that the Jews who had returned to Judah were having a hard time, and that the walls of Jerusalem were broken down and the gates had been burned.
有一天，尼希米聽到消息：回到猶大的猶太人處境艱難，耶路撒冷的城牆被拆毀，城門也被火焚燒。
He didn't eat any food for days and prayed to God for the Jews.
他好幾天不吃東西，為猶太人向神禱告。
He told God he was sorry for the wrong things he and his people had done.
他向神認罪，為自己和同胞所犯的錯懺悔。
He reminded God of his promises, and that God had said, "If you obey my commands, I will gather you together again."
他求神記念祂的應許，神曾說：「你們若遵守我的誡命，我必再招聚你們。」
Nehemiah asked for God to give him success as he went to ask the king for help.
尼希米求神在他去求王幫助時，使他順利。
Nehemiah went to do his job for the king.
The king asked why Nehemiah was sad.
王問尼希米為甚麼面帶愁容。
So Nehemiah told the king about his people in Judah.
尼希米就把猶大同胞的事告訴王。
Nehemiah prayed and told the king he wanted to rebuild the city of Jerusalem.
尼希米默默禱告，然後告訴王，他想重建耶路撒冷城。
He asked for letters from the king that would help him travel safely to Jerusalem and get the supplies he needed to rebuild the city.
他求王賜下詔書，讓他平安抵達耶路撒冷，並取得重建城所需的材料。
God helped Nehemiah, and the king gave Nehemiah all he asked for.
神幫助尼希米，王就把他所求的都賜給他。
Nehemiah went to Jerusalem and checked out the walls.
尼希米到了耶路撒冷，察看城牆。
He went to the people and said, "Come on, let's rebuild the wall of Jerusalem."
他到百姓那裡說：「來吧，我們來重建耶路撒冷的城牆！」
And the people agreed and started that good work.
百姓都同意，就開始做這美好的工作。
Meanwhile, there were some officials from nearby lands who heard Nehemiah was rebuilding the wall and were upset.
這時，鄰近地方的一些官員聽說尼希米在重建城牆，就很不高興。
They laughed at the Jews and made fun of them.
他們嗤笑猶太人，嘲弄他們。
But Nehemiah said, "The God of heaven will give us success. We serve him."
尼希米卻說：「天上的神必使我們亨通，我們是事奉祂的。」
Many Jews worked together to rebuild the wall, including the priests, men who worked with gold, a man who made perfume, leaders from nearby villages, servants, guards, traders, and daughters as well.
許多猶太人同心重建城牆，包括祭司、金匠、做香料的、鄰近村莊的首領、僕人、守衛、商人，還有女兒們。
All the people worked with all their hearts.
百姓都全心全意地做工。
The officials from other lands planned to fight the Jews, but the Jews prayed to God and put guards on duty day and night.
外地的官員計劃攻擊猶太人，但猶太人向神禱告，並安排守衛晝夜看守。
Nehemiah stationed people to defend the city where it was weak.
尼希米在城牆薄弱的地方派人防守。
From that day on, half of the people did the work with swords at their sides, and the other half were armed to defend the people working and the city.
從那天起，一半的人腰間佩刀做工，另一半的人拿著兵器，保護做工的人和整座城。
Nehemiah reminded them, "Our God will fight for us."
尼希米提醒他們：「我們的神必為我們爭戰！」
They worked from sunrise until the stars came out.
他們從日出一直做到星宿出現。
After fifty-two days, the city wall was finally finished.
五十二天後，城牆終於完工了。
All of Judah's enemies were afraid, because they realized that God helped the people finish the work.
猶大所有的仇敵都懼怕了，因為他們知道這工作是神幫助百姓完成的。
Jerusalem was large. It had a lot of room, but only a few people lived there.
耶路撒冷城很大，有許多空間，住的人卻很少。
So God gave Nehemiah the idea to gather more people to come and live in Jerusalem, now that the wall had been rebuilt.
於是神感動尼希米：既然城牆已經重建，就招聚更多人來住在耶路撒冷。
And many people returned home to Israel as God gathered his people together again.
許多人回到故土，神再次招聚了祂的子民。
A teacher of God's law named Ezra came and read the Book of the Law to all the people who could understand.
一位名叫以斯拉的律法教師，向所有能聽明白的百姓宣讀律法書。
Then they worshiped God and promised to follow God's commands.
於是他們敬拜神，並承諾要遵行神的誡命。
